meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 它会先读取 lark-shared 的认证说明，然后拉取指定日期的日程和未完成任务，整理成摘要：含日程表、待办列表、会议/待办计数、冲突提醒和空闲时段。
howto.when: 当你询问今天/明天/本周的日程和待办（如“今天有什么安排”“明天有什么会”“开工摘要”）时触发；仅支持 user 身份。

say.note: 会获取今日日程和未完成任务并汇总。
查明天日程和截止前的未完成任务。

say.text: 帮我出本周的 standup report。
say.note: 会按日期范围汇总本周日程与待办。

howto.what_en: It first reads the lark-shared auth notes, then fetches the target date's calendar events and unfinished tasks, and organizes them into a summary: agenda table, to-do list, meeting/to-do counts, conflict alerts, and free time slots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about today's, tomorrow's, or this week's schedule and to-dos (e.g. "What's on today?", "Any meetings tomorrow?", "standup report"); supports only user identity.

say_en.note: Fetches today's events and pending tasks and summarizes.

say_en.text: What meetings and to-dos do I have tomorrow?
say_en.note: Checks tomorrow's agenda and tasks due before then.

say_en.text: Please prepare this week's standup report.
say_en.note: Summarizes this week's schedule and tasks by date range.
